> MIDI by Asher is a custom MIDI controller designed in KiCad. The goal of this project is to build a compact controller with different types of inputs that can be used to control music software and MIDI-compatible instruments. Features: 3 slide potentiometers for continuous control 1 EC11 rotary encoder 3 SK6812 MINI-E RGB LEDs 2 Kailh Choc low-profile mechanical switches 7 capacitive touch keys Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero microcontroller

## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I had to really lock in today like insane cook today i finished the whole project from the schematic and feature choices to design and artwork and branding pretty much everything, anyways i called it

**13h**

I had to really lock in today like insane cook today i finished the whole project from the schematic and feature choices to design and artwork and branding pretty much everything, anyways i called it MIDI by Asher(my name), idk why i just thought it was good enough.

It features:
3 Bourns Slide Potentiometers
1 EC11 Rotary Encoder
3 SK6812 MINI-E Neopixels
2 Kailh Choc Low Profile Switches
7 Capacitive Touch Keys
1 Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero

i made lots of design choices, artwork choices and feature choices in a very short period which i found very difficult. My next step are finishing the read me, shipping and buying the stuff.
